October 7 Anniversary, Black Sea Drone Attack, FBI Whistleblower & Paramount-Warner Deal

Also onSpotifyApple PodcastsYouTube MusicRSS feed

Israel marks three years since the October 7th Hamas attack as memorials and demands for accountability continue. Bulgaria ends its search after a drone attack sinks a cargo ship in the Black Sea, while the origin of the strike remains disputed.

Also today: a former FBI analyst says President Trump pushed for an investigation of protesters after seeing them on TikTok; Paramount completes its $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery; a former senior CIA official pleads guilty in a massive fraud case; and a Washington man is accused of helping plan a deadly Canadian school shooting.

We also cover Disney and ABC's court fight with the FCC, a Chicago woman's lawsuit after being shot by a Border Patrol agent, record support for Medicare for All, and the investigation into Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike.
